configuration.change: Full-field H-alpha filaments and diffuse gas from the SHASSA fallback.

source.source: SHASSA Field013, continuum-subtracted unsmoothed, 0.8 arcminute native pixels
source.faintConfidence: The published 4 arcminute median-filtered continuum-subtracted map supplies a continuous detection weight, rising from zero at 1 noise level to unity at 3 noise levels above its exterior reference. Unsmooth morphology is retained in detected areas.
source.starResidualMethod: Only bright continuum pixels above the 99.5th percentile with paired positive/negative stellar subtraction residuals beyond 4 local MAD (minimum 20 dR) are replaced by their 2–3 pixel annular line median. Filaments elsewhere are unchanged.
source.diffuseMethod: A 200 pc half-width box mean supplies a broad morphology. DIG=min(total,globalFactor*mean), with the single factor fixed to 35% integrated H-alpha. Compact=total-DIG, preserving every source cell. The 30–40% prior is Kennicutt et al.1995.
source.dustCorrection: Conditional OGLE red-clump foreground internal A_V; H-alpha optical depth 0.75 A_V/1.085736. No Horálek pixels. This assumes ionized gas sees the tracer column; gas ordering is not measured.
source.support: Observed 13 degree field. A fixed physical fade from 5.5 to 6.5 kpc suppresses unrelated foreground sky at the field boundary; it is an adopted extent, not a measured edge.
source.limitations: SHASSA includes residual stars and coarse resolution. This fallback cannot claim the 3 arcsecond detail of MCELS. Exterior background subtraction does not separate structured Milky Way H-alpha from LMC emission exactly.
source.depth: Each cloud is a finite isotropic kernel. Its center receives a deterministic line-of-sight depth whose FWHM is its parent nebula geometric-mean sky diameter; width is resolution-limited. Published 30 Dor shell chords are used where intersected. The surrounding diffuse gas stays on the 150 pc Gaussian warped layer. No columns are extruded along the Earth direction.
source.relativeLight: The full survey supplies each catalogue region’s relative on-sky shape. Each region is normalized to its accepted parent luminosity; those amplitudes stay fixed. Regions unresolved or absent in the coarse fallback keep their prior geometry. The diffuse map has unit area, with its global luminosity fixed to35/65 of the previous compact budget before the common gas RGB grade.

details.frozen: All stars, grades except gas, bar, warp, dust and adopted stellar/diffuse layer heights.

method.window: 31×31 native pixel crops, enlarged tenfold. Central 9×9 mean RGB and brightness. Texture is 29×29 high-pass RMS after a 3×3 box mean, divided by mean luminance.
method.spatialSource: Catalogues and survey maps only. The photo supplies global material calibration and evaluation, never spatial pixels.

calibration.method: Three global gas RGB coefficients; per-pin central color/light plus 0.1 times the normalized 31 pixel crop error in positive red excess after a 3 pixel mean. No source geometry or target pixels are fitted as a field. Earlier blue guards use the accepted l32 reference samples.

qualification.wcsAdapter: The temporary LMC projection header uses the full CD1_1, CD1_2, CD2_1, CD2_2 matrix and omits redundant CDELT1, CDELT2, CROTA1, CROTA2 cards. Published bytes remain untouched; packages/fits is unchanged.
qualification.units: dR: decirayleigh, 0.1 R per stored intensity unit.
qualification.primaryMCELS: The original CTIO MCELS release endpoint returned HTTP404 on 26 October 2026. No qualified full continuum-subtracted MCELS file was found in bounded release discovery. This is the owner-authorized SHASSA fallback, not a 3-arcsecond MCELS product.
